Sanding cabinets are also useful in removing old paint, glue, and other coatings.
Cabinets with large openings are used for sanding large and flat surfaces, like the floor.
These are usually made of thick metal or wood and can be adjusted in angle for better efficiency.
Cabinets with adjustable heights are useful for sanding small to medium sized workpieces.
To make a sanding cabinet, you will need the following things:
- Sandpaper or steel wool,
- Sanding pad, and
- Sanding block.

Materials Needed-
A. You will need a piece of plywood, measuring 2 feet by 4 feet for the base of the cabinet.
B. You must also have a piece of MDF or particle board, measuring 2 1/4 feet by 2 1/2 feet, for the cabinet door and shelf.
